status.current: accepts Stella's special four-on-one match as a convenient chance to eliminate her

relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Would have met Rinna in B-block round two, likely arranging an Akatsuki withdrawal without a real fight.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Treats Stella's self-imposed penalty as amusing and advantageous.
relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: One of the Akatsuki pieces used in Tsukikage's tournament plan.

periods.summary: Reisen enters the volume at the end, when Stella proposes that all remaining B-block fighters join her delayed first-round match as punishment for her tardiness. He laughs at the opportunity and accepts, recognizing that Stella has given Akatsuki a favorable chance to remove a major threat. Stella's actual motive is to stop Akatsuki members such as Reisen and Rinna from arranging noncompetitive withdrawals in later rounds.

key_events.summary: Accepts Stella's four-on-one challenge from the audience.
